column3: Saori Route · Determination Towards a Bitter Future
Even then, Kyousuke-shi...
You don't have to make a big show about disliking it.
Even I will feel a little hurt.
Ah... Perhaps I went a little too far?
But still, how can I accept those goods when I don't even know what's going on?
Damn, what am I supposed to do?!
Sorry, I went a little too far.
If you feel bad about that...
Then there's no problem if you accept those goods!
Nonono, there is a problem.
I'm not making any progress...
The more I try to find out the truth, the more it feels like I am bogged in a deep quagmire.
Does she not care about the contents of that backpack?
What does Saori thinks of otaku goods right now?
Maybe she doesn't need these otaku goods anymore...?
No, no... That's impossible!
When she passed over the goods, sorrow rose in her eyes, I did not miss that.
Anyway, I can't take your stuff.
If that's the case, then take it as a case of me lending it to you for now.
It officially remains my stuff. You don't have a problem with it that way?
Huh? UOH?!
Please do me this favor, Kyousuke-shi!
...Man, can't be helped...
Alright, I will take care of it for you.
HaHa! Blissful gratitude!
Then, please take care of it for me for a while.
Isn't this something really important to you... to the extent that that you'd call it your soul?
Describing it as my soul... You're exaggerating again.
I am not. This is your way of life, your identity.
To pass it so easily to someone else, I don't know what your ulterior motives are.
I don't have such a thing. I just want to have you hold it.
Can't it be Kirino or Kuroneko?
I gave Kiririn-shi a figure out of goodwill in the past, and she ended up adding decorations to it...
Sadly, I am afraid the same thing might happen again...
As for Kuroneko-shi, she says there's no space in her room to store it.
I see...
That's why, I intend on having you accept it no matter what.
Hmm...
Okay. If you're going this far, I'll take it.
R-Really?!
Yes. However, I have a condition.
Since this is your stuff, I'll only holding onto it for you. When you need it back, you can come get it any time.
B-Blissful gratitude!
Yeah, I'll accept your passion and soul.
Haha! I am indebted to you!
Ah...
I haven't paid my share for the maid cafe...!
I took care of it for you, so rest assured.
Really? Sorry about that.
Is this much enough?
It's all right. You helped me a lot today, so don't worry about the money.
In return, please take good care of the goods.
Yup, understood.
Well then Kyousuke-shi, see you.
